resources.string: Multiview plays up to four feeds at once: web pages, streams and IP cameras.\n\nPress OK to add feeds. To send them from your phone instead, choose Phone remote there and scan the code.
Lost the feed. Trying again in %1$d s…
Didn\'t start after %1$d reloads.\nReload it from the menu.
This page refused access (%1$d).\nSFM won\'t reload it by itself.
The page stopped. Starting it again…
Login rejected (401).\nCheck the camera\'s username and password in Edit feeds.\nSFM won\'t retry it by itself.
Access refused (403).\nSFM won\'t retry it by itself.
The camera\'s certificate has changed, so SFM stopped.\nIf you changed it yourself, edit the feed to trust the new one.
This camera\'s certificate hasn\'t been trusted yet. Edit the feed to check it.
Videos from private browsing aren\'t sent to Multiview: it would save them.
Couldn\'t find this video\'s stream. Add to Multiview (in the menu) adds the page instead.
The video\'s link was refused (403); sites often make them expire.\nSend it again from the browser, or add the page instead.
https://… a page, a stream, an <iframe> tag, or https://user:password@camera/…
Password (leave empty to keep the saved one)

%1$s presents this certificate (SHA-256):

%2$s

Compare it with the one in the camera's own settings. SFM will send the login to this camera only while it presents exactly this certificate.
Only http and https addresses play in Multiview.
Camera logins are only sent over https.
Cameras on the home network have to use https.
Camera logins aren\'t sent from the phone. Add the login on the TV.
That isn\'t an address SFM can read.
Every site leaves Most visited. Your history is kept; a site comes back once you visit it often again.
Four web feeds are a lot for this TV. They can take a few minutes to all start, and one may pause to buffer now and then. Two run smoothly.
Clean view: Left or Right plays that side’s sound. OK mutes or unmutes; Menu for the rest.
Bookmarked as “%1$s”. Open it from Bookmarks or the home screen to show these feeds.
For example: News, or Saturday games
Nothing to bookmark: add a web page or stream first. Cameras aren’t bookmarked.
